home.title: Find Your Perfect
home.subtitle: Book unique homestays surrounded by mountains, rivers, and forests. Experience authentic Thai hospitality in nature.
home.featureMountainDesc: Wake up to misty peaks and fresh air
home.whyText: We connect travelers with authentic nature homestays run by local hosts across Thailand. Every property is hand-selected for its natural beauty, hospitality, and unique character. Book easily with PromptPay.
home.policyIntro: Your privacy matters to us. Here's how we handle your data:
home.policy1: We collect only the information needed to process your booking — name, email, phone number, province (optional), and payment slip.
home.policy2: Your personal data is never sold or shared with third parties for marketing purposes.
home.policy3: Payment slips are verified securely and stored only for booking confirmation. Duplicate slips are automatically detected and rejected.
home.policy4: We use cookies to improve your experience. You can accept or decline cookies when prompted.
home.policy5: QR-based check-in, check-out, and review data is collected to manage your stay and improve our service.
home.policy6: You can request deletion of your data at any time by contacting us. Hosts can delete their entire account from the dashboard.
home.termsIntro: By using Peaksnature, you agree to the following terms:
home.terms1: Bookings are confirmed only after successful payment verification. Slips may be auto-verified or reviewed manually by the host.
home.terms2: Guests may choose to pay the full amount or a deposit. The remaining balance must be settled on arrival via transfer or cash.
home.terms3: Selected dates are temporarily held while you complete payment. If payment is not completed in time, the hold expires and dates become available again.
home.terms4: Peaksnature acts as a platform connecting guests with hosts. We are not the accommodation provider.
home.terms5: Guests are responsible for providing accurate contact information and using the QR code to check in and check out at the property.
home.terms6: Hosts reserve the right to set their own pricing, availability, seasonal rates, and house rules.
home.terms7: Cancellation policies vary by homestay. Please check with the host before booking.
home.contactIntro: Have questions or need help? We'd love to hear from you.

dashboardGuide.title: Setup Guide
dashboardGuide.subtitle: Follow these steps to get your homestay ready for guests
dashboardGuide.step1Desc: Set up your contact and payment information so guests can reach you and pay securely.
dashboardGuide.step1Item2: PromptPay ID (required — used for guest payment QR)
dashboardGuide.step1Item3: Deposit amount (optional, default is full payment)
dashboardGuide.step1Item4: Notification preference: Push notification or LINE
dashboardGuide.step2Desc: Connect LINE Messaging API so you receive booking alerts via LINE. This requires a LINE Official Account.
dashboardGuide.step2Item1: Go to LINE Developers Console (developers.line.biz) and log in
dashboardGuide.step2Item2: Create a new Provider (or select existing), then create a Messaging API channel
dashboardGuide.step2Item3: In the channel settings, go to "Messaging API" tab and issue a Channel Access Token (long-lived)
dashboardGuide.step2Item4: Copy the Channel Access Token and paste it into the "LINE Channel Access Token" field in your Profile
dashboardGuide.step2Item5: Find your LINE User ID in the "Basic settings" tab of the channel (starts with U)
dashboardGuide.step2Item6: Copy the User ID and paste it into the "LINE User ID" field in your Profile, then save
dashboardGuide.step3Desc: Add your property details so guests know what to expect.
dashboardGuide.step3Item1: Name, slug (your booking page URL), tagline & description
dashboardGuide.step3Item4: Images: logo, hero banner, and gallery photos
dashboardGuide.step4Desc: Add an interactive map to your booking page so guests can find your homestay easily.
dashboardGuide.step4Item1: Open Google Maps (maps.google.com) and search for your homestay location
dashboardGuide.step4Item2: Click the "Share" button, then select the "Embed a map" tab
dashboardGuide.step4Item3: Copy the HTML code — it looks like: <iframe src="https://www.google.com/maps/embed?..."></iframe>
dashboardGuide.step4Item4: Paste only the URL from inside src="..." into the "Map Embed URL" field in your Homestay settings
dashboardGuide.step4Item5: The URL should start with https://www.google.com/maps/embed
dashboardGuide.step5Desc: Choose a brand color that reflects your homestay's style.
dashboardGuide.step5Item1: Pick from preset colors or enter a custom hex code
dashboardGuide.step5Item2: Preview how it looks on your booking page
dashboardGuide.step6Desc: Set up rooms with pricing and photos for guests to book.
dashboardGuide.step6Item1: Room name, description, price per night, max guests, quantity
dashboardGuide.step6Item3: Seasonal pricing (optional — set different prices for specific date ranges)
dashboardGuide.step7Desc: Block out dates before you go live to avoid unwanted bookings.
dashboardGuide.step7Item1: Block dates for maintenance or personal use
dashboardGuide.step7Item2: Block per-room or for the entire homestay
dashboardGuide.verifyItem1: Visit your booking page to see how it looks to guests
dashboardGuide.verifyItem2: Make a test booking to verify notifications arrive correctly

aboutPage.title: About Peaksnature
aboutPage.intro: Peaksnature is a platform for discovering and booking homestays surrounded by nature. We create a space that connects travelers who want to relax close to nature with local hosts who want to share their places and experiences.
aboutPage.belief: We believe the best travel is not just about visiting new places, but truly experiencing the nature, lifestyle, and culture of local communities.
aboutPage.focus: Peaksnature focuses on presenting unique accommodations such as homestays, mountain lodges, or nature retreats that help travelers relax in peaceful atmospheres different from typical hotels.
aboutPage.storyP1: The idea behind Peaksnature came from the desire to make finding nature homestays easier.
aboutPage.storyP2: In many areas, there are beautiful and unique homestays or lodges that remain unknown online, making it impossible for many travelers to discover them.
aboutPage.storyP3: Peaksnature was created to be a platform that helps:
aboutPage.storyP4: We believe that connecting people with nature creates more meaningful travel experiences.
aboutPage.mission: Peaksnature's mission is to make finding and booking nature homestays easy, transparent, and accessible for everyone.
aboutPage.missionP2: We want to support tourism that generates income for local communities and promotes nature-respectful travel.
aboutPage.diff1Desc: Our platform focuses on accommodations near nature such as mountains, forests, rivers, or rural areas.
aboutPage.diff2Desc: Peaksnature helps homestay owners present their properties to travelers easily without relying on large platforms.
aboutPage.diff3Desc: The platform has systems to make bookings clear, including:
aboutPage.diff3P: These help build confidence for both guests and hosts.
aboutPage.travelersP: Whether you're looking for a weekend getaway or a nature trip, Peaksnature is ready to help you find the right place.
aboutPage.hostsIntro: Peaksnature opens opportunities for homestay or nature lodge owners to join the platform and present their properties to travelers.
aboutPage.hostsP: We want to help local accommodations reach travelers more easily.
aboutPage.joinP: Peaksnature is more than a booking platform. We want to build a community of nature-loving travelers and hosts who want to share authentic relaxation experiences.

trustSafetyPage.intro: Peaksnature is committed to creating a safe, transparent, and trustworthy platform for both guests and hosts.
trustSafetyPage.introP2: We use technology and verification processes to help reduce risks in accommodation bookings.

trustSafetyPage.paymentItem1: Detection system for reused payment slips
trustSafetyPage.paymentItem3: Verification by host or system administrator

trustSafetyPage.reviewItem1: Help other users make easier decisions
trustSafetyPage.reviewNote: Inappropriate or false reviews may be removed by the platform.
trustSafetyPage.qrIntro: To make stays convenient and verifiable, Peaksnature uses:
trustSafetyPage.qrNote: This helps hosts verify stays systematically.
trustSafetyPage.securityIntro: We have measures to protect user data, including:
trustSafetyPage.securityNote: Personal data is used only for platform service purposes.
